optimization_config.rationale: Default level-set optimisation parameters for the 2D cantilever: hmin/hmax set to about 1/100 and 1/10 of the domain scale; diffusion regularisation 1e-4; initial velocity 1e-3; 30 iterations; uniform solid initial level-set phi=-1; clamped boundary label 4 is fixed, labels 1 and 2 are free/Neumann boundaries.
